subject: Lakota YouthStay Program
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviews West Medford residents Joy Harris and Bruce Roberts about the Lakota YouthStay program, an initiative connecting youth from the Pine Ridge Reservation with host families in the Medford area. The guests discuss the program's origins, cultural exchange goals, pandemic adaptations, and community impact.

items.title: Episode Introduction and Land Acknowledgement
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduces the podcast topic and reads a land acknowledgement recognizing the traditional homelands of the Massachusett and Wampanoag peoples.

items.title: Guest Introductions and Local Favorite Dining
items.summary: West Medford residents Joy Harris and Bruce Roberts introduce themselves and share their favorite local dining spots in Medford.

items.title: Lakota YouthStay Overview and Pine Ridge Reservation Context
items.summary: Joy Harris and Bruce Roberts outline the Lakota YouthStay homestay program and detail the demographic and socioeconomic conditions on South Dakota's Pine Ridge Reservation.

items.title: Program Origins and Community Building
items.summary: Joy Harris explains how volunteer trips and conversations with Pine Ridge youth following a spike in local suicides inspired the establishment of the homestay program in 2015.

items.title: Pandemic Challenges, Program Logistics, and Summer Activities
items.summary: Joy Harris and Bruce Roberts describe how COVID-19 impacted operations and highlight the educational, cultural, and recreational activities offered during host weeks.

items.title: Fundraising and Broader Impact on Medford
items.summary: Joy Harris and Bruce Roberts explain that the volunteer-run program relies on donations and grants, and share their hopes for expanding indigenous land recognitions and cultural events in Medford.
